author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Well, the first trailer for the new Harry Potter show on HBO is out now. Let's take a look. Meanwhile, Stephen Colbert is somehow writing a new LOTR movie, and in other news, Starfleet Academy is cancelled. Join me, MauLer, Reaper, HeelvsBabyface, Despot of Antrim and Writing Wrongs for Open Bar 178.
